description: Human approval packet model the IDE can display before source mutation. Carries trace_id, workspace_identity, diff_hash, diff_summary, files_changed, verifier_result, model_route_ref, patch_plan_ref, temp_patch_ref, risk_summary, approval_required, approval_status, operator_identity, operator_signature, timestamp, stale_after. Evaluator returns a closed-set status token. Never applies source mutation.
